# Copilot Instructions

- When editing or writing code in this repository, use English for all comments and human-readable text in code.
- This includes:
  - code comments
  - docstrings
  - log messages
  - error messages
  - CLI help text and prompts
  - any string literals intended for developers or users
- Preserve Spanish only for external documentation or user data when explicitly required by the project.

## Example prompts

- "Add a unit test with English comments."
- "Refactor this function and keep all in-code text in English."
- "Update the report generator so output text remains English."
